verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for an AI app-building SaaS like Figma Make, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics opt-out, or any privacy controls. The available items cover chat, design attachment, backend, MCP and publishing features only.
